items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I played the Café Society Downtown with Art Tatum, Lena Horne, Henry Red Allen, Jay C. Higgenbotham, Doc Cheatham and J. C. Heard

ctx.x: You know, when you are a promoter, or you are the recipient of something good, it's a strange feeling. Sometimes you ask yourself, "What did I do to deserve this?" Here are three thousand people coming, walking, running, in cabs and buses, coming out to hear these singing groups...The Five Blind Boys, The Pilgrim Travelers and The Soul Stirrers. And I had them...I played them in four concerts--Denison, Greenville, Dallas and Paris, Texas. Very, very successful. So it's that funny feeling that you get, Dan,…

But in New York City guys wondered for years how I was making it, and I had a very simple pattern. I went to the World Series, I went to the fights, you know, I played the Café Society Downtown with Art Tatum, Lena Horne, Henry Red Allen, Jay C. Higgenbotham, Doc Cheatham and J. C. Heard and ....firma la porte moi!.......Open the window!.....
Eddie Heywood and Art, of course, Teddy Wilson...is there a piano player named Kenneth Spencer? No, Kenny Spencer was a singer. What's this boy's name used to play with Red Allen?
